study_principles.primary_estimand: Attacked-run post-onset unique sink delivery fraction, equal weight across onset and radio/channel and physical attacker position within each geometry; source and sink delivery only; 30 geometry block means
study_principles.factorial: All onset, RX, timing, attack-position and four matched arms crossed within each geometry. Relay label permutation alternates across blocks, balanced 8/7 per clipping stratum.
study_principles.geometry: 15 clipped / 15 unclipped source-progress geometries, 50 m UDGM transmission range, <=48.5m required hop distances, fixed sink (90,0), no direct source-sink link
study_principles.critical_failure: All offered packets: critical sink loss or lateness. Not signed receipt deadline.
study_principles.negative_control: Benign/no-attacker runs at RX 0.8 and 1.0; estimate unintended negative feedback penalties descriptively. No inference that RX loss is congestion.
study_principles.inference: Two-sided Monte Carlo sign-flip for paired 30 geometry effects, 200000 random assignments with reproducible seed; conditional on sign symmetry, not treatment randomization; 20000 geometry bootstrap pointwise CI; separate Holm 6-test family per endpoint.
study_principles.scope: New Cooja study NOT YET EXECUTED. Earlier 1440-run study unchanged. Q22 actor/checkpoints frozen; no retraining. No physical radio/current or MCU timing/provisioned security claims.
study_principles.constraints: No post-outcome selection, no dropping technical failures, full case-audit requirement; state launch costs before extensive cloud execution.
